data: Microsoft reported operating income of $109,433 million for fiscal 2024, the year ended June 30, 2024, up from $88,523 million in fiscal 2023. Amazon reported operating income of $68,593 million for fiscal 2024, the year ended December 31, 2024, up from $36,852 million in 2023. Microsoft's figure is about 1.60 times Amazon's, a gap of roughly $40.8 billion. This is despite Amazon's much larger revenue of $637,959 million against Microsoft's $245,122 million, which gives Microsoft an operating margin of about 44.6% compared with about 10.8% for Amazon. The two fiscal years are not aligned: Microsoft's ends in June and Amazon's in December, so the periods overlap by only six months.
